title: 集合价值
tex: \widehat V(\mathbf a\mid s)=\sum_{e\in U(\mathbf a)}\max_{i\in I_e(\mathbf a)}\widehat g_i(e\mid s)+\sum_{\{e,f\}\subseteq U(\mathbf a)}\widehat h_{\mathbf a}(e,f\mid s)

title: 共同潜势
tex: \Phi(\mathbf a\mid s)=\widehat V(\mathbf a\mid s)-\sum_{i:a_i\ne\varnothing}\widehat c(a_i\mid s)

title: 边际贡献效用
tex: u_i(a_i,\mathbf a_{-i}\mid s)=\Phi(a_i,\mathbf a_{-i}\mid s)-\Phi(\varnothing,\mathbf a_{-i}\mid s)

title: 最大可行偏离
tex: \delta(\mathbf a\mid s)=\max\!\left\{0,\max_{\substack{i,a_i'\\(a_i',\mathbf a_{-i})\in\mathcal A(s)}}\!\left[\Phi(a_i',\mathbf a_{-i}\mid s)-\Phi(\mathbf a\mid s)\right]\right\}
